reason: I already pay every month for a big fitness app that has a postpartum plan, and I barely get through that one. I might grab the free week at 3am, but I'm not paying for a second program that does the same thing.
objection: I already pay for a fitness app with a postpartum plan, so what does this give me that mine doesn't? A mum of three and a physio who reviewed it isn't the same as a physio actually checking on me.
would_change_my_mind: If the free week showed my tummy gap actually closing, or my physio said this is better for diastasis than my current app's plan, I'd cancel my subscription and pay the $19.99 instead.
